title: Helping Hands Benefit Sale Raises $30,077 for Wichita’s Littlest Heroes
description: This year’s Helping Hands Benefit Sale was one for the books! On Wednesday, June 18th, the lanes were full, the bids were strong, and thanks to the incredible generosity of our dealer community, we officially crushed our $30,000 goal - raising a total of $30,077 for Wichita’s Littlest Heroes!
